payload.title: Trademark knowledge base: public legal data, corpus and data-driven analysis
payload.description: Build a serious knowledge base of US trademark law on Papyrus from public-domain sources, starting with TTAB decisions and extending to Federal Circuit and federal court opinions, USPTO Office actions and expungement/reexamination records. Shelves in S3, catalog in DynamoDB; text extraction; a self-improving taxonomy and ontology; and data-driven investigations published as stories and live data pages. Wiki: [data sources](project/wiki/data-sources.md), [analysis ideas](project/wiki/analysis-ideas.md), [first research pass](project/wiki/ai-at-the-uspto-2026-10.md).
